title: Epoch AI Projects 2027 Chip Supply Can Run 1.9 Billion Agents
summary:
The total computing power from upcoming hardware shipments could soon equal the weekly working hours of the global human workforce. Epoch AI estimates that AI chips shipped through 2027 may provide enough capacity to support 1.9 billion DeepSeek V4 Pro agents running concurrently, which would match the work of 8 billion people working 40 hour weeks. For higher-end frontier models, the infrastructure could support 30 million to 170 million concurrent agents, equivalent to the hours of 140 million to 720 million full time employees.

A gap exists between this theoretical capacity and current market demand. Utilizing only 20% of the estimated capacity would require between $2.6 trillion and $5.3 trillion in annual API spending, yet total developer revenue is projected to reach only $1 trillion by the end of 2027, even with 5x annual growth. The final number of deployed agents will depend on whether demand remains high and how model efficiency evolves.
